name: Tag Pairings
tip: Type a tag and a space to see related tags. Shift+Enter or Tab adds one, and the list opens again. Enter adds a tag only after Up or Down.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Tag Pairings is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
